QUOTE: `app/hooks/navigation_header.tsx` (`useAppNavigationHeader`) renders the internal `Header` from `components/navigation_header/header.tsx`, not `NavigationHeader`, so it never creates a search field. It is used by `app/routes/(authenticated)/thread.tsx`, which passes `hasSearch={false}`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explicitly distinguishes the hook's `Header` from `NavigationHeader` and excludes it from the renderer list; the thread route is mentioned as using the hook rather than being counted.
